projects.name: CollabMind Platform Launch
projects.description: Building a real-time collaborative workspace featuring dynamic whiteboard sketches, interactive Kanban boards, and Gemini API project ideation.

tasks.title: Design System Architecture
tasks.description: Outline the REST endpoint structures, Socket.IO message payloads, and MongoDB schema relationships.

tasks.title: Configure JWT & Role-Based guards
tasks.description: Implement backend authentication middleware and React protected routes filtering navigation links.

tasks.title: Real-time Whiteboard Canvas Sync
tasks.description: Integrate HTML5 Canvas drawing events and broadcast line strokes to other project users via Socket.IO.

tasks.title: Connect Gemini Brainstorming API
tasks.description: Mount generative models routes that analyze project metadata and user prompts to suggest project milestones.

tasks.title: Initialize Express + React project base
tasks.description: Configure standard folders layout, Vite compiler settings, Tailwind CSS, and server node scripts.

tasks.title: Launch Social Media Campaign
tasks.description: [Marketing] Draft 5 release announcements highlighting core features and schedule posts on LinkedIn and Twitter.

tasks.title: Collect Beta User Feedback
tasks.description: [Research] Distribute feedback surveys to initial testers to gather testimonials and identify usability issues.

tasks.title: Setup Product Landing Page
tasks.description: [Design] Design a high-converting landing page with registration forms, screenshots, and call-to-action buttons.

tasks.title: Define Target Customer Profile
tasks.description: [Marketing] Analyze market needs related to impact training  to create demographic sheets representing early adopters.

notes.title: Project Kickoff Notes
notes.content:
# CollabMind Launch Guidelines

Welcome team! Here are our core milestones:
1. **Real-time collaboration**: Canvas sketch maps & chat.
2. **AI Assistance**: Generating subtasks on demand.
3. **Financial integrity**: Real-time budget monitoring limits.

Keep updates clean and test routes locally!
